## isva-p02-v13 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** What do others sift?

**Premises.**
- By others too (paraiḥ taiḥ api), of reasons (hetūnāṃ), in pot-self-sifting (ghaṭātmapravivecane).
- Locus-form alone (saṃsthānamātram) ... even (eva) ... [gap] ... causehood (hetutvam) of the conscious-possessor (buddhiśālinaḥ).

**Inference.** Others too sift reasons in pot-self-analysis: bare locus-form [carries] the conscious one's causehood.
